description: List the accepted values of one open-vocabulary search filter, with live job counts, so the code you write sends a value the index holds. Filters match exactly: an unknown value returns zero jobs, not an error. Facets: sources, skills, industries, company_categories, job_categories, job_subcategories, occupations. `sources` are ATS ids (greenhouse, lever_co); `job_categories` and `job_subcategories` are the occupation taxonomy's two upper levels; `occupations` returns occupation ids for the `occupation_ids` filter. Without `q`: the values with the most live jobs. With `q`: the values that start with it; for `occupations`, `q` is a role name ('registered nurse') matched against occupation, subcategory and category names. Needs the Jobo API key in this server's `Authorization: Bearer` header; a sandbox key (jbe_test_…) cannot use it. Free: rate limited, never billed.

q.description: For occupations, words of the role name ('nurse', 'backend developer'). For the other facets, the start of a value ('pyth', 'soft'). Leave out for the most common values.

name: find_filter_values
title: Find filter values
